## Accurate completion boundary

The bounded software implementation is complete and qualified as a reference system. It is not production-certified because the following evidence requires real external infrastructure or independent organizations:

- hardware hsm kms pkcs11.
- physically independent multi host wan.
- certified physical device pilot.
- large licensed real world training.
- thirty actual wall clock days.
- independent security safety operational audit.

No package-local flag, self-signed receipt or edited qualification file can close these external gates.
